item.title: Winterplace hosting Gear Swap yard sale and Pond Skim event on March 8
item.description: If you've got used gear collecting dust in the garage, here's your chance to clear it out or score something new. Winterplace is hosting a gear swap and yard sale this Sunday, March 8. Starting at 9:00 a.m., bring your used ski or snowboard gear and equipment to the back deck of the mountain house. And the fun doesn't stop there, Winterplace says, come for the yard sale but stay for the Pond Skim. The splash-filled tradition returns to Winterplace at the Mountain House. item.title: Summer Flea Market Series kicks off on June 27 at Raleigh County Convention Center; Now accepting vendor registrations
item.description: If you love a good treasure hunt, mark your calendars. The Beckley Raleigh County Convention Center will host an indoor summer flea market series packed with vintage finds, handmade goods, unique treasures, and local vendors. On the last Saturday of each month, beginning on June 27 through August 29, shoppers can browse antiques, collectibles, home décor, crafts, and so much more. #RaleighCounty #WOAY
